senses.gloss: m. (ἐπίλογος, epilogus) concluding speech, argument, inference; peroration.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:16">Koh. R. to X, 16</cite> <he>התחיל א׳ וכ׳</he> (Solomon) in his wisdom began a concluding argument; (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 72:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXII</cite> <he>פיו נובע</he>!)
